thread:
maya: Quick sync — thinking through a 'soft handoff' notification flow for automatic rollouts. Goal: let operators know when traffic will shift to fallback model, how long it stays there, and where to find audit trace. Thoughts?

sam: +1. Need both in-console visual + ephemeral alerts. In-console: banner + compact timeline on route page.

leo: Can we avoid banner spam? only show when rollout enters degrade mode or when operator threshold is hit. Banner should show estimated reversion ETA and reason.

maya: Agreed. Proposal: show 3 states: NOTICE (info, non-blocking), PAUSED (operator ack required for certain policies), and HANDOFF (auto switch occurred). Each state has a small CTA: "View trace" / "Mute for 1h" / "Open runbook".

anika: For traces, prefer a single click to open the exact rollout trace + request sample. Perf wise include sampling link.

sam: Telemetry: include fields in notification payload: `route_id`, `policy_id`, `trigger_code`, `trigger_sample_id`, `started_at`, `switch_eta`, `expected_fallback_model`, `revert_ttl_s`.

maya: Nice. Draft payload example:
```
{
  "route_id": "payments-tx",
  "policy_id": "auto-fallback-v2",
  "trigger_code": "500-spike",
  "trigger_sample_id": "samp_9831",
  "started_at": "2026-03-18T14:10:30Z",
  "switch_eta": "2026-03-18T14:12:00Z",
  "expected_fallback_model": "gpt-lite-quant",
  "revert_ttl_s": 900
}
```

leo: We should keep `trigger_code` enumerable and human-friendly. Add `confidence` or `severity` too.

anika: Audit: each notification should link to an immutable audit entry id that contains the policy eval inputs + sampled request payload (redacted PII). Link stored in `audit_id`.

maya: UX question: should the banner show the audit summary inline or just link out? My vote: short summary + link.

sam: Also push ephemeral Slack/email for oncall with `@oncall` mention, but only if policy severity >= high or if manual pause required.

leo: We need operator controls in console: "Snooze notifications for route", "Force revert", "Pin policy for monitoring".

anika: For privacy: sampled payloads redacted and retention configurable per org. Make the default 7d.

maya: One more: show small heatmap of recent triggers in banner tooltip (count, last 15m). helps quick triage.

sam: Edge cases: cascading handoffs when fallback capacity is exhausted. UI should indicate partial handoff (x% traffic) vs full.

leo: Implementation note: APIs: events.v1/rollout_notifications POST with above payload + optional `partial_pct`.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: rollout-notify-service -> v1.2 at 2026-03-18T15:00Z :rocket:

maya: TODOs: 1) Sam draft payload + enumeration list 2) Anika audit retention policy doc 3) Leo mockups for banner + timeline 4) Maya wire up Slack/email cadence. Who owns? assign in next sync.

sam: I'll take the payload enums and Slack rules.

le o: I'll do the mockups (typo corrected: leo)

anika: I'll draft audit retention + redaction.

maya: Great, meeting in 30. :coffee:
